user.title: Set up Virtual Meter
user.description:
Select the reachable Home Assistant IPv4 address and a serial number (1–20 printable ASCII characters).

Discovery defaults to UDP 6600. Port 10086 is available for experimental SPC231 testing; authentication and complete firmware compatibility are unverified.

Unit ID: 11 for new setups; 0 accepts any incoming ID (legacy mode).

data.unit_id: Modbus unit ID (0 = any, 11 = default for new setups)

error.invalid_port: Enter an integer port from 1 to 65535.
error.invalid_unit_id: Enter an integer unit ID from 0 to 255 (0 accepts any ID).

error.invalid_address: Enter a register address from 0 to 65535.
error.invalid_port: Enter an integer port from 1 to 65535.
error.invalid_unit_id: Enter an integer unit ID from 0 to 255 (0 accepts any ID).

abort.no_registers: No registers configured yet. Use 'Add a new register mapping' first.
abort.settings_saved: Settings saved. Port changes automatically reload the integration; unit ID changes apply immediately.
abort.invalid_address: Enter a register address from 0 to 65535.

init.title: Virtual Meter Options
init.description: What would you like to do?

edit_registers.title: Edit Registers
edit_registers.description: Here you can see all configured registers as a list. To delete a register, simply clear both the entity and fixed value fields.

edit_settings.title: Settings
edit_settings.description:
A discovery port change reloads the integration and keeps register mappings. UDP 10086 is experimental for SPC231; TLS/proprietary authentication is unsupported.

Unit ID: 0 accepts any ID (legacy mode), 1–255 filters on the selected ID. Unit ID changes apply immediately without reloading.
